label: M1: swap adjacent operands
subgoals: List the operands in order, ignoring operators
Swap two neighbouring operands in that list
Keep every operator in its original position

label: M2: complement a chain
subgoals: Find the maximal runs of consecutive operators
Complement every operator in the chosen chain
Confirm the alternating chain stays normalized

label: M3: swap an operand and an operator, with a check
section: M3: swap an operand and an operator, with a check
subgoals: Swap an adjacent operand and operator
Check every prefix for the balloting property
Reject results with two identical adjacent operators
